children: Nauticus Robotics entered into a Fifth Amendment to its Senior Secured Term Loan Agreement to extend the loan’s maturity. The amendments, dated Sep 14, 2026 and effective Sep 17, 2026 upon receipt of a collateral agent consent, push the maturity date to Jan 31, 2028. The change is intended to provide additional runway and financial flexibility.
: Fifth Amendment to senior secured term loan agreement (maturity extension)

: Extend debt maturity and improve liquidity
